## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Sayings-Record of Chán Master Běijiàn Jūjiǎn* — a one-juan Southern-Sòng *yǔlù* of **Běijiàn Jūjiǎn** 北磵居簡 (1164–1246), Línjì-Yángqí master and notable Chán literary-cultural figure of Southern Sòng. Compiled by his disciple (*cānxué* 參學) [Dàguān](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A4%A7%E8%A7%80) 大觀.
